verdict.rationale: An IP-office portal with online filing, searchable databases and an open-data API could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring jobs such as recurring searches or watch alerts, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents any scheduling, recurring workflow or automation capability. The pack covers one-off filing procedures, database search and a token-gated data portal only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
